references.view: 2025 river-front oblique view: monumental framed glazing below three receding roof/terrace tiers; main street corner clipped. Rear glass-roof elevation remains uncertain.

licenseScope: CC BY applies to original artistic contributions only; ODbL applies to OSM-derived spatial data. Reference photographs retain their own licenses.
assistance: AI-assisted architectural interpretation and procedural recipe authoring; deterministic Python/Blender export. No photographic textures.
modelingNotes: OSM defines the whole retail block, a northern 21 m mass and an internal glass-roof footprint. The southern river frontage has no part height. The inspected 2025 front photograph shows the monumental lower facade with three receding rooftop stages.

The southern frontage is explicitly inferred at 23 m with terraces at 27 and 30 m, inward setbacks 1.6 and 3.5 m, and a shallow 32 m roof crown. The northern mass retains its mapped 21 m height. These are map-scale interpretations, not survey measurements.

The mapped internal glass roof uses an inferred 21 m eave/24 m ridge based on its rooflight role; sparse references do not resolve its exact section. Structural glazing uses glass; wall panels use window. Storefront lettering, iron ornaments, mosaics, sculptures and fine balconies are omitted.
The historical side photograph supports the broad framed glazing rhythm; the 2025 river-front photo supports the stepped renovated silhouette. Both dates are retained in reference metadata.
